name: vanthrex-ibmi
description: A friendly, all-in-one IBM i workbench for VS Code with an AI assistant (@vanthrex): connection wizard for several systems, library & IFS browser, edit and compile with inline errors, call graph & impact analysis, Db2 for i SQL with autocomplete and explain, table data editor, debugger, system dashboard, jobs & messages, RPG navigation, fixed-to-free conversion and code checks.

viewsWelcome.contents:
No IBM i systems yet. Add one in a few seconds with the guided form.
[$(add) Add IBM i Connection](command:vanthrex.addConnection)
[Open the Getting Started guide](command:vanthrex.openWalkthrough)

Your library list is empty.
[$(add) Add Library](command:vanthrex.addLibrary)

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Vanthrex for IBM i
walkthroughs.description: Connect to your IBM i, browse source, compile and run SQL.

steps.title: Add your IBM i connection
steps.description:
Use the guided form to enter host, user and library list. Passwords are stored in the VS Code secret store.
[Add Connection](command:vanthrex.addConnection)

steps.title: Browse libraries and open members
steps.description: Open the Vanthrex view, expand a library, then a source file, and click a member to edit it like a local file.

steps.title: Compile with one key
steps.description: Press Ctrl+Alt+C (Cmd+Alt+C on Mac) in a member. Errors appear inline and in the Problems panel.

steps.title: Run SQL
steps.description:
Open an SQL scratchpad and press Ctrl+Enter to run the statement under the cursor. Results open in a filterable grid you can export to CSV.
[Open SQL Scratchpad](command:vanthrex.newSqlScratchpad)

steps.title: Monitor and explore your system
steps.description:
Open the System Dashboard, check active jobs and answer QSYSOPR messages, search objects (Ctrl+Alt+O) or source code (Ctrl+Alt+F), and edit table data in a grid.
[Open System Dashboard](command:vanthrex.openDashboard)

steps.title: Ask the AI assistant
steps.description:
Type **@vanthrex** in the chat to explain RPG, write SQL against your real tables, fix compile errors or modernize code. Right-click in a source → **Vanthrex AI**.
[Ask @vanthrex](command:vanthrex.ai.open)

steps.title: Put your source in Git
steps.description:
Right-click a library → **Git: Export Source to a Git Repository**, then use **Get Changes from IBM i** / **Upload Changed Files** to keep both sides in step. See every version of a member with **Git: History of This Member**.
[Export a library](command:vanthrex.git.export)

vanthrex.compileActions.markdownDescription: Compile actions. Variables: `&LIB` (source library), `&OBJLIB` (target library), `&SRCFILE`, `&NAME`, `&EXT`, `&FULLPATH` (IFS path), `&CURLIB`, `&USER`. Add `OPTION(*EVENTF)` to get inline errors.

default.name: Create Bound RPG Program (CRTBNDRPG)
default.command: CRTBNDRPG PGM(&OBJLIB/&NAME) SRCFILE(&LIB/&SRCFILE) SRCMBR(&NAME) OPTION(*EVENTF) DBGVIEW(*SOURCE) REPLACE(*YES)

default.name: Create RPG Module (CRTRPGMOD)
default.command: CRTRPGMOD MODULE(&OBJLIB/&NAME) SRCFILE(&LIB/&SRCFILE) SRCMBR(&NAME) OPTION(*EVENTF) DBGVIEW(*SOURCE) REPLACE(*YES)

default.name: Create SQL RPG Program (CRTSQLRPGI)
default.command: CRTSQLRPGI OBJ(&OBJLIB/&NAME) SRCFILE(&LIB/&SRCFILE) SRCMBR(&NAME) OBJTYPE(*PGM) COMMIT(*NONE) OPTION(*EVENTF) DBGVIEW(*SOURCE) CLOSQLCSR(*ENDMOD) REPLACE(*YES)

default.name: Create Bound CL Program (CRTBNDCL)
default.command: CRTBNDCL PGM(&OBJLIB/&NAME) SRCFILE(&LIB/&SRCFILE) SRCMBR(&NAME) OPTION(*EVENTF) DBGVIEW(*SOURCE) REPLACE(*YES)

default.name: Create CL Program (CRTCLPGM)
default.command: CRTCLPGM PGM(&OBJLIB/&NAME) SRCFILE(&LIB/&SRCFILE) SRCMBR(&NAME) OPTION(*EVENTF) REPLACE(*YES)

default.name: Create Command (CRTCMD)
default.command: CRTCMD CMD(&OBJLIB/&NAME) PGM(&OBJLIB/&NAME) SRCFILE(&LIB/&SRCFILE) SRCMBR(&NAME) OPTION(*EVENTF) REPLACE(*YES)

default.name: Create Display File (CRTDSPF)
default.command: CRTDSPF FILE(&OBJLIB/&NAME) SRCFILE(&LIB/&SRCFILE) SRCMBR(&NAME) OPTION(*EVENTF) REPLACE(*YES)

default.name: Create Printer File (CRTPRTF)
default.command: CRTPRTF FILE(&OBJLIB/&NAME) SRCFILE(&LIB/&SRCFILE) SRCMBR(&NAME) OPTION(*EVENTF) REPLACE(*YES)

default.name: Create Bound RPG Program from IFS (CRTBNDRPG)
default.command: CRTBNDRPG PGM(&OBJLIB/&NAME) SRCSTMF('&FULLPATH') OPTION(*EVENTF) DBGVIEW(*SOURCE) REPLACE(*YES) TGTCCSID(*JOB)

default.name: Create SQL RPG Program from IFS (CRTSQLRPGI)
default.command: CRTSQLRPGI OBJ(&OBJLIB/&NAME) SRCSTMF('&FULLPATH') OBJTYPE(*PGM) COMMIT(*NONE) OPTION(*EVENTF) DBGVIEW(*SOURCE) CVTCCSID(*JOB) REPLACE(*YES)

default.name: Create Bound CL Program from IFS (CRTBNDCL)
default.command: CRTBNDCL PGM(&OBJLIB/&NAME) SRCSTMF('&FULLPATH') OPTION(*EVENTF) DBGVIEW(*SOURCE) REPLACE(*YES)

vanthrex.sql.maxRows.description: Maximum number of rows fetched into the SQL result grid.

vanthrex.sql.confirmDestructive.description: Ask for confirmation before running DELETE, DROP, TRUNCATE or UPDATE without WHERE.

vanthrex.tempDirectory.description: IFS directory used for temporary files during member transfer.

vanthrex.spool.maxEntries.description: Maximum number of spooled files listed.

vanthrex.autoConnectLast.description: Reconnect automatically to the last used system when VS Code starts.

vanthrex.objects.showAll.description: Show an 'Objects' folder (programs, files, service programs…) under each library.

vanthrex.dashboard.refreshSeconds.description: How often the System Dashboard refreshes (seconds). 0 = only when you click Refresh.

vanthrex.dataEditor.pageSize.description: Rows per page in the table data editor.

vanthrex.history.enabled.description: Keep a local copy of every member and IFS file you open or save, so you can compare and restore.

vanthrex.history.maxVersions.description: Local history versions kept per member / file.

vanthrex.lint.enabled.description: Check RPG sources as you type.

vanthrex.lint.maxProcedureLines.description: Report procedures longer than this many lines.

vanthrex.lint.rules.markdownDescription: Turn individual RPG checks on or off.

unused-definition.description: Variables, constants and subroutines that are declared but never used

long-procedure.description: Procedures longer than the configured number of lines

empty-on-error.description: ON-ERROR blocks that silently swallow errors

mixed-format.description: Fixed-format calculation specs in a free-format source

vanthrex.sourceDates.enabled.markdownDescription: Read and save members **with** their sequence numbers and change dates (SRCSEQ/SRCDAT), like SEU. Unchanged lines keep their date; changed lines get today's date. Needs a Mapepire SQL engine; otherwise members are copied as plain text.

enumDescriptions: Show the change date in front of each line
Show sequence number and change date
vanthrex.sourceDates.display.description: What to show in front of each member line (Ctrl+Alt+D cycles).

vanthrex.sourceDates.format.description: Date format: SEU-style YYMMDD or ISO YYYY-MM-DD.

vanthrex.conflictCheck.description: Warn when a member is locked by another job, or changed on the IBM i after you opened it, before your save overwrites it.

vanthrex.members.sortBy.description: Order of members in the Libraries view.

vanthrex.sql.scriptStopOnError.description: Run SQL Script: stop at the first statement that fails (off = run every statement and report failures).

vanthrex.debug.port.description: IBM i Debug Service secured port. 0 = read it from the service configuration (usually 8005).

vanthrex.debug.ignoreCertificateErrors.description: Connect to the Debug Service even when its certificate cannot be verified. Only for test systems.

vanthrex.debug.updateProductionFiles.description: Allow the debugged program to update files in production libraries (UPDPROD).

vanthrex.debug.trace.description: Write a trace of the debug protocol to the IBM i Debug output (for support).

vanthrex.connections.keepOthersOpen.description: Keep other systems connected when you connect to another one, so you can switch between them instantly (Ctrl+Alt+S).

vanthrex.callGraph.depth.description: How many levels of callers / callees the call graph shows at first.

vanthrex.callGraph.maxNodes.description: Largest number of objects drawn in a call graph.

vanthrex.callGraph.hideSystemObjects.description: Leave IBM-supplied objects (QCMDEXC, QSYSPRT…) out of the call graph.

vanthrex.ai.enabled.description: Enable the @vanthrex AI assistant and the AI commands. Code you ask about is sent to the language model you selected in VS Code chat.

vanthrex.ai.useTools.description: Let the AI assistant look things up on the connected IBM i (object descriptions, table columns, source, read-only queries).

vanthrex.ai.allowQueries.description: Let the AI run read-only SQL queries (SELECT / WITH / VALUES only; anything that changes data is refused).

vanthrex.ai.confirmQueries.description: Ask before the AI runs a query on the IBM i.

vanthrex.ai.maxSourceChars.description: Largest amount of source text sent to the language model in one request.

languageModelTools.name: vanthrex_runQuery
languageModelTools.userDescription: Run a read-only Db2 for i query on the connected IBM i.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Runs ONE read-only Db2 for i SQL statement (SELECT, WITH or VALUES) on the IBM i connected in Vanthrex and returns up to 200 rows as text. Statements that change data are refused. Use it to look at data, catalog views (QSYS2.SYSTABLES, QSYS2.SYSCOLUMNS) and IBM i services (QSYS2.ACTIVE_JOB_INFO, QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS, …). System naming LIB/FILE works.

languageModelTools.name: vanthrex_readSource
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read a source member or IFS stream file from the connected IBM i.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns the text of a source member given as LIBRARY/FILE(MEMBER), e.g. MYLIB/QRPGLESRC(ORDENTRY), or of an IFS stream file given as an absolute path, from the IBM i connected in Vanthrex. Use it to read copybooks, called programs or prototypes.

languageModelTools.name: vanthrex_describeObject
languageModelTools.userDescription: Describe an IBM i object: attributes, source, columns of a file, modules of a program.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Describes an IBM i object given as LIBRARY/NAME (optionally with a type such as *PGM, *SRVPGM, *FILE): type, attribute, text, owner, size, dates, source member; for files also the columns (name, type, length, text) and indexes; for programs the bound modules and their source.

languageModelTools.name: vanthrex_searchObjects
languageModelTools.userDescription: Find IBM i objects by name or description.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Finds objects on the connected IBM i whose name or text description matches a pattern (* is a wildcard), in the user's library list or in one library. Returns library, name, type, attribute and text. Use it to find the real table or program names before writing SQL or code.

pattern.description: Name or text, e.g. CUST* or customer

library.description: One library (optional; default the library list)

languageModelTools.name: vanthrex_systemStatus
languageModelTools.userDescription: CPU, disk, jobs waiting for a reply and the latest QSYSOPR messages.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns the connected IBM i's CPU and system ASP use, job counts, jobs in MSGW (waiting for a reply) and the latest QSYSOPR messages. Use it to answer questions about system health or stuck jobs.

scripts.package: npm run typecheck && npm run build -- --production && vsce package --no-dependencies
